REQUEST FOR QUOTATION (RFQ)

Customer Name: Zenith Chemical Processing Ltd.
Contact Person: Ananya Sharma (Technical Buyer)
Email: a.sharma@zenithchem.com
Date: 26th September 2026

Dear Vertex Sales Team,

We require urgent pricing for high-corrosion chemical handling valves for our new acid treatment plant in Gujarat.

Requirement Details:
1. Item: Industrial Valve IV-200
   - Material Grade: Heavy Duty SS316 High-Corrosion Grade Variant
   - Quantity: 50 units

2. Delivery & Commercial Terms:
   - Requested Delivery: Guaranteed doorstep delivery within 3 business days to Surat.
   - Payment Terms: 90 Days post-installation credit terms.

Please confirm pricing and availability for SS316 grade immediately.

Regards,
Ananya Sharma
Zenith Chemical Processing Ltd.

Subject: Clarification on Your Request for Quotation (demo-rfq-2-zenith) — Vertex Industrial Supplies

Dear Zenith Chemical Processing Ltd.,

Thank you for reaching out to Vertex Industrial Supplies Pvt. Ltd. We have received your RFQ (demo-rfq-2-zenith) and our commercial sales team has initiated the review.

To ensure our formal quotation precisely aligns with your technical specifications and approved commercial terms, could you please clarify the following point(s)?

  • Clarification Required (Industrial Valve IV-200): requested grade 'SS316' is not stocked; approved grades: CARBONSTEEL, SS304. Please confirm the acceptable requirement before a formal quotation is issued.
  • Commercial Credit Policy Mismatch: Customer requested 90-day credit terms. Standard company policy is Net 30 Days. Requires CFO approval.

As soon as you confirm, we will promptly issue your formal quotation and delivery schedule.

Warm regards,
Commercial Sales & Engineering Team
Vertex Industrial Supplies Pvt. Ltd.
sales@vertexind.com | +91 20 2712 3456
